privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Transcend collects, safeguards, and handles organizational and personal data across our courier logistics workspace.

collect.title: 1. Information We Collect
collect.content: Transcend collects the information needed to provide multi-tenant courier and logistics management services. This includes account details (username, email address and, if you sign in with a password, a securely hashed copy of it), 42 profile information (the email address on your 42 profile) if you sign in with 42, profile details, organization memberships, parcel waybill data, recipient contact information, driver assignments, and vehicle asset records. For each sign-in session and each action recorded in the audit trail, we also store the IP address and browser user agent it came from.

telemetry.title: 2. Operational Data
telemetry.content: To run dispatch, the platform records each parcel status change with its time and the account that made it. Location coordinates and proof of delivery (a signature and a doorstep photo) are planned features. They are not collected yet, and this policy will be updated before they are.

security.title: 3. Data Security & Tenant Isolation
security.content: We implement strict organizational boundaries to protect tenant data. Data is protected in transit using HTTPS (TLS encryption) and access is strictly governed by role-based access control (RBAC). Data belonging to one organization is logically isolated and inaccessible to unauthorized tenants.

oauth.title: 4. Third-Party Services & OAuth
oauth.content: Transcend integrates with third-party authentication providers, including the 42 School OAuth 2.0 API. When you authenticate using 42, we never receive your 42 password; we only retrieve the email address on your 42 profile to find your Transcend account.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies & Browser Storage
cookies.content: Transcend uses only the cookies needed to sign you in. A refresh-token cookie keeps you signed in: page scripts cannot read it, it is sent only to the sign-in service, and your session ends after 7 days without use or after 30 days at most. Signing in with 42 sets a second cookie for 10 minutes to protect that sign-in. The short-lived access token is kept only in the open page's memory. Your language choice is saved in your browser's local storage. We use no advertising or analytics cookies.

retention.title: 6. Retention & Your Rights
retention.content: Audit-trail entries, which record who did what and when, are kept for a fixed period from the time of the action: 365 days for sign-ins and other security events, 180 days for changes to company data and platform administration, and 90 days for records of who viewed the audit trail or activity reports. They cannot be deleted before that period ends. Logistics and financial ledger records are kept for as long as your organization needs them for its operations and accounts. Users have the right to inspect their personal information, request corrections, or request account deactivation through their organization administrator.

updates.title: 7. Updates & Contact
updates.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time; the date at the top shows the latest version. For questions about data privacy or compliance, email privacy@transcend.com or contact your organization administrator.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The guidelines and conditions governing access to and use of the Transcend platform and services.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing or using the Transcend platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you are using the service on behalf of an organization or courier enterprise, you represent that you have authority to bind that entity to these terms.

service.title: 2. Description of Service
service.content: Transcend provides a multi-tenant logistics ERP platform encompassing parcel tracking, fleet management, driver dispatch, staff administration, and financial reconciliation ledgers.

accounts.title: 3. Account Responsibilities & Security
accounts.content: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials and session tokens. You must notify your system administrator immediately if you suspect unauthorized access to your account or organizational workspace.

use.title: 4. Acceptable Use
use.content: You agree not to misuse the platform, interfere with platform operations, attempt unauthorized penetration testing, reverse engineer private services, or submit fraudulent parcel and ledger entries.

financial.title: 5. Financial & Settlement Disclaimer
financial.content: Financial ledgers, fee estimates, and merchant cash-on-delivery calculations provided within the platform are operational tools intended to assist organizational reconciliation. Organizations are ultimately responsible for auditing their own books and commercial settlements.

availability.title: 6. Service Availability & Changes
availability.content: We continuously improve the platform and reserve the right to deploy updates, perform scheduled maintenance, or modify available features. While we strive for high uptime, the service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis.

termination.title: 7. Termination
termination.content: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to accounts that violate these Terms or present operational and security risks to other tenants.
